sections.title: Reviews to finish
sections.sql: select reference,name,service,owner,state,review_due,open_actions from v_review_queue order by review_due nulls first,reference

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select reference,service,action,owner,due_on,days_overdue from v_action_queue order by due_on,reference

sections.title: Recurrence and unfinished work
sections.sql: select service,owner,criticality,incidents,unfinished,last_30_days,avg_minutes_to_resolution,overdue_actions from v_service_health order by service

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by reference,rule
